# ADR-044 — Production `daily_brief` route reuses the existing `gpt-4.1` model row; per-release source directories; build images before migrating

**Status:** Locked

<!-- Decision text below is verbatim from the pre-split docs/DECISIONS.md table row (2026-09-16). Do not edit a Locked decision without explicit owner approval. -->

**Production `daily_brief` route reuses the existing `gpt-4.1` model row** (`313633f4-2c52-4a06-a696-4f7740a95f28`, connection `My OpenAI`), primary-only with no fallback — no new provider connection, no new `ai_models` row and no credential handling. Chosen over a cheaper dedicated model or the Groq connection because it adds zero new credential surface and the model is already proven in production for capture parsing; cost is negligible at manual on-demand cadence. Note there is **no DELETE endpoint for task routes**, so reverting requires another upsert repointing `primary_model_id` or direct SQL. Phase 5 deployment also establishes that production releases build from a **per-release source directory** (`/home/himallinux/personal-os-<checkpoint>-release`, shipped via `git archive`) with the stable `.env` at `/home/himallinux/personal-os/.env`, which removes the Checkpoint 4.7 `rsync --delete` deletion-manifest hazard; and that **images must be built before migrations are applied**, because the migration runs from the api image (Checkpoint 5.7, user-approved 2026-08-24)
